title: Getting Started
description: The homepage every role lands on first. Shows live counts for open alerts, active cases, and screening volume, plus quick links into whichever module you use most — configurable per role so an analyst and an MLRO see different priorities.

title: Case Manager
description: Where a confirmed alert becomes a full investigation. Case Queues, a defined Case Lifecycle from review to sign-off, and an audit trail of every action taken along the way.

title: Alert Manager
description: Every alert from Screening or Monitoring lands here first. My Queue, All Cases, and Admin View give analysts, supervisors, and MLROs the visibility their role needs, with SLA countdowns on every row.

title: Customer Management
description: Every customer's profile in one record — KYC details, risk score, and full screening history. The single source of truth other modules (Case Manager, Name Screening) read from and write back to.

title: STR Listing & Reports
description: One row per filed Suspicious Transaction Report, linking back to the originating case and its transactions — plus the filter, export, and share views supervisors and regulators use on top of the same data.

title: AI Manager
description: Drafts a first-pass summary for incoming alerts and cases, then configures everything behind that drafting on two tabs: Prompt Config (the versioned instructions it follows) and Model Config (the model identity, API key, and Temperature it runs on, with full history and Restore).

title: Name Screening
description: Four ways in — Watchlist Search, Manual Screening, scheduled Batch runs, and Delta Screening for ongoing customers — with the matching weightages and severity bands behind every hit set once in its own Configuration area.

title: Automation
description: Configures how Name Screening and Transaction Monitoring alerts automatically become cases — which alert types feed case creation, and how they group together based on customer, case age, and status.

title: Transaction Monitoring
description: Typologies (rules) built from reusable Variables evaluate every transaction against your thresholds, versioned through Draft, Shadow, and Published states. Group By, Look Back, and Suppression shape exactly when — and how often — an alert should fire.

title: Data Ingestion
description: Scheduled Watchlist and TMS (transaction) ingestion jobs, with a clear job history so you can see exactly when data last landed and whether it validated cleanly.

title: Admin
description: Every platform-wide setting in one place — your own profile, who can do what (Roles & Permissions), quick links into every configuration screen, and the organizational Hierarchy that case and alert routing runs on top of.

title: Help & Reference
description: Straight answers to the questions compliance teams ask most, every AML and platform term defined once in the Glossary, and a direct line to support when something needs a human.
